notes: Ensure that the README maintains its original intent while enhancing clarity and structure.

steps.description: Review the current README.md for existing content and structure
steps.details: Open the README.md file and carefully read through its content to understand the existing sections, information, and overall structure. Note any areas that are unclear or poorly structured.

steps.description: Identify areas for improvement in clarity and structure
steps.details: Based on the review, list specific areas where the README can be improved in terms of clarity, readability, and structure. Consider the flow of information and the use of headings.

steps.description: Revise the README.md to enhance clarity
steps.details: Edit the README.md to improve clarity. Rewrite sentences that are unclear, use simpler language where possible, and ensure that the information is presented in a straightforward manner. Maintain the original intent of the content.

steps.description: Organize the README.md content into a logical structure
steps.details: Reorganize the content of the README.md to follow a logical structure. Use appropriate headings and subheadings to break down the content into sections. Ensure that the flow of information is logical and easy to follow for a new user.

steps.description: Proofread the README.md for grammatical and spelling errors
steps.details: Carefully proofread the README.md to correct any grammatical or spelling errors. Ensure that the document is polished and meets production-quality standards.
